Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding of no domestic supply. Related entity 'VEGA AUTO ACCESSORIES PRIVATE LIMITED' appears in the same dataset as a distinct counterparty name — the claimed legal name 'VEGA AUTO ACCESSORIES LIMITED' is the one with the shipment records.
